subtitle: Turn long videos into concise, meaningful highlights.
privacy: Everything runs locally. Your videos are not uploaded to third-party AI services.

upload.formats: MP4, MOV, MKV, AVI, WebM, M4V · up to 8 videos in one highlight

config.maxSequenceHint: Hard maximum for any single continuous clip. Longer moments are cut to the most important part. Shorter clips stay shorter.
config.minSequenceHint: Optional floor for a single clip when the source moment is long enough. Leave empty in Auto to use the default (1.5s).
config.minSequenceCustomHint: Each clip stays at least this long when the source moment allows it.
config.sequenceAutoHint: Clip length follows the content. A hook can be 2s; an important explanation or action can stay 8–12s or longer if cutting would lose meaning. Set a minimum below only if you need longer clips.
config.prioritiesHint: Choose what the editor should prefer. Balanced keeps a mix. Select more than one and use the sliders to weight them.
config.allowRepeatHint: When off, the same idea, action, or visual is selected only once. Unique moments are preferred.
config.maxRepeatHint: Hard maximum for total repeated content when repeats are allowed. Shorter is acceptable; this is never a target.
config.cropHint: Only the selected area is used for scene detection, transcription, AI analysis, and highlight generation. The original files stay unchanged. The same crop is applied to every uploaded video.
config.customFocus: What should the final video focus on?
